name: Edgar County, IL
findings: Edgar County has 70 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Edgar County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Edgar County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
